prompt:
Create ONE complete illustration for a historical city-building game, one continuous scene, NOT a contact sheet, no collage, no inset panels. Reference 1 sets the muted hand-painted naturalistic storybook landscape style; reference 2 contains multiple examples ONLY for brushwork and materials (do not copy its multi-panel layout); reference 3 sets grounded painted human face style. Southern England in 1318–1347, ordinary timber/plaster/thatch medieval buildings with NO household chimneys, muted ochres, dusty reds and grey greens, subtle painted texture, soft natural light, modest human scale, no modern objects. No words, letters, numbers, captions, interface, border or watermark. No horror, no gore. Landscape format 640:480, fill complete image edge to edge. One continuous image.
